question: Can Fish Audio Drama 3 run on this machine and narrate Nell?
verdict: runs locally via audio.cpp GGUF on Vulkan; draft narration produced; not release-ready

runtime.name: audio.cpp
runtime.vulkan_sdk_glslc: LunarG SDK 1.4.363 (extracted to local prefix; Ubuntu glslc 2025.2 cannot compile ggml's integer-dot-product/bfloat16 shaders)

model.note: community GGUF quantisation, not the reference implementation; upstream checkpoint is ~39 GB plus 1.87 GB codec and needs CUDA-oriented serving stacks

reference_voice.source: zhaochenyang20/seed-tts-eval-mini en/prompt-wavs/common_voice_en_10119832.wav, the clip published in the Drama 3 model card
reference_voice.license_note: Mozilla Common Voice test clip, used as a temporary narrator reference only

checks.word_diff: normalized diff against source flagged only homophones/onomatopoeia after the page 22 retake

defects_found_and_handled.defect: inserted line 'Watch them now.' plus 11 s silence
defects_found_and_handled.fix: text_chunk_size=4000; two seeds then read the page correctly

defects_found_and_handled.defect: 'Grandma let out the breath' instead of 'Nell'
defects_found_and_handled.fix: re-rendered at seed 7, export uses that take

defects_found_and_handled.defect: 'His rain stopped' transcribes as 'reins/reign' in both seeds

defects_found_and_handled.status: transcribes correctly at seed 7; ambiguous ASR

multi_speaker_test.result: both <|speaker:0|>/<|speaker:1|> spans rendered with two reference clips
multi_speaker_test.not_verified: distinct per-character timbre; pitch-shifted synthetic second reference is plumbing evidence only

limitations: Q4_K community quantisation, not FP8/bf16 upstream
no human listening or pronunciation review
mechanical ASR checks cannot judge warmth, timing or homophones
Vulkan heap is about 37 GiB of the 96 GiB carve-out; larger packages were not needed
